notes.title: Cave Crawler 2
notes.content:
Cave Crawler 2 is now available to wishlist on Steam. The game is scheduled for a 2024 release and will be completely free to play.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000490/Cave_Crawler_2/

Cave Crawler 2 will feature:
[list]
[*] 15 levels
[*] 3 boss fights
[*] A custom level editor
[*] New and returning enemies
[*] Exanded soundtrack
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who supported Cave Crawler over the past few years, and I hope you enjoy the sequel.
